name: 裴重恩
objective:
This course teaches how deep learning is applied to satellite and space-technology data, from the measurement physics of a satellite image to a model running on an onboard computer. Students learn the data contract of Earth-observation datasets (chips, labels, honest splits, metrics), convolutional and transformer models, geospatial foundation models (Prithvi-EO-2.0, Clay, TerraMind), model compression for payload hardware (pruning, quantisation, distillation) and onboard autonomy. Every technique is introduced through a real mission or product (ESA Φsat-1/2, Planet Pelican, FORMOSAT - 8A, JPL Dynamic Targeting). Taught in English with open data (Sentinel-1/2, Landsat, Planet open datasets) and open models; the final project is an individual model demonstrated live on an ASV Lab edge board.

本課程講授深度學習於衛星與太空科技資料之應用：從衛星影像的量測物理出發，到模型於機上電腦實際執行。內容涵蓋地球觀測資料集契約（切片、標註、誠實的資料分割與評估指標）、卷積網路與 Transformer、地理空間基礎模型（Prithvi-EO-2.0、Clay、TerraMind）、酬載硬體之模型壓縮（剪枝、量化、蒸餾）與機上自主。每項技術皆以真實任務或產品引入（ESA Φsat-1/2、Planet Pelican、福衛八號、JPL Dynamic Targeting）。全英語授課，使用開放資料與開放模型；期末為個人專題，於 ASV Lab 邊緣運算板上實機展示。
schedule:
W1 9/7 — Course introduction; remote-sensing story; space technology fundamentals (orbits, sensors, GSD). HW1: one-page EO problem statement. 課程介紹；遙測與太空科技基礎。

W2 9/14 — AI applications in space; satellite data as measurement: data cube, bands, GeoTIFF, radiometry. Lab 0. 太空 AI 應用；衛星資料即量測。

W3 9/21 — Classical image processing; the dataset contract: chips, labels, splits, metrics, mission cost. Lab 1. 傳統影像處理；資料集契約。

W4 9/28 — Teachers’ Day, no class. 教師節放假。

W5 10/5 — Object detection and tracking on aerial/UAV imagery (recorded lecture + TA workshop, UAVDT). Lab 2. 航空/無人機影像物件偵測與追蹤。

W6 10/12 — Neural networks and CNNs for Earth observation; U-Net; convolution quiz. 神經網路與卷積網路；U-Net。

W7 10/19 — Efficient CNNs for satellite payloads: depthwise-separable convolution, regularisation, residual and attention blocks, IoU losses; missions Φsat-2 and Pelican. Project topic approval (individual). 衛星酬載之高效 CNN；專題題目核准（個人）。

W8 10/26 — Retrocession Day makeup, no class (data collection week). 光復節補假（資料蒐集週）。

W9 11/2 — Transformers and geospatial foundation models (Prithvi-EO-2.0, Clay, TerraMind). Lab 4: fine-tune Prithvi on Sen1Floods11. Transformer 與地理空間基礎模型。

W10 11/9 — Anniversary makeup, no class. 校慶補假。

W11 11/16 — Adaptation and honest evaluation: probing, LoRA, full fine-tuning; held-out geography, time, sensor; midterm review. Lab 5. 模型調適與誠實評估；期中複習。

W12 11/23 — Midterm exam (written, sessions 1–8). 期中考（筆試）。

W13 11/30 — Generative AI for Earth observation: super-resolution, cloud removal, diffusion, validation. Trained model due. 生成式 AI 於地球觀測；完成模型訓練。

W14 12/7 — Onboard AI: ground vs flight, pruning, quantisation, distillation, ONNX/OpenVINO export, latency on the edge board. Lab 6. 機上 AI：模型壓縮與邊緣板延遲量測。

W15 12/14 — Onboard autonomy and mission agents: dynamic targeting, Φsat-2, fault detection, agentic mission planning. Demo dry run. 機上自主與任務代理；預演。

W16 12/21 — Final project demonstration on ASV Lab edge boards and oral presentation of the report; instructor comments returned (replaces the final exam). 期末專題實機展示與口頭報告，教師回饋（取代期末考）。
